prompt: Create a hyper-realistic street photograph of an elderly Japanese biker with slicked-back white hair, a gray goatee, black sunglasses, black leather gloves, black boots, dark jeans, and a black embroidered leather jacket sitting confidently on a bizarre custom motorcycle built entirely from vegetables, inspired by a modern Obon spirit horse. Set the scene on a realistic urban Japanese street with a beige concrete wall, metal railing, sidewalk, and a partially visible parked black compact car in the background. Use natural overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, documentary realism, detailed vegetable textures, glossy eggplant skin, rough cucumber bumps, cinematic contrast, and a slightly low eye-level camera angle. No text, no watermark, no cartoon styling.
